observations.design_hypothesis: For apparel catalogs, material and fit attributes can complement color/size/price facets, while lookbook modules should route shoppers into relevant assortments. Verify stock, price, material and delivery claims before display.

best-seller/new/bundle tabs with variant color selectors

blog, featured product, press and office story
shipping/service panels and newsletter
observations.design_hypothesis: Accessory catalogs benefit from clear device-generation navigation and color choices in product cards; complementary-product recommendations can help shoppers complete compatible setups. Verify compatibility, availability, discounts and fulfillment claims.

benefit-led coffee hero and tabbed category/product merchandising
ingredient/science editorial, Shop the Look products, testimonials and FAQ
guarantee and newsletter
observations.design_hypothesis: Benefit-led navigation and product education may help wellness shoppers compare a wide supplement/coffee range; keep category labels and practical pickup/product details easy to find. Health, efficacy and guarantee claims need substantiation.

homepage_modules: video-led cycling hero and announcement
featured trail-bike collection
product feature stories and category links
service proposition strip, promotion countdown, testimonial, blog and newsletter
observations.design_hypothesis: High-consideration sport products benefit from visible fit/technical information and service context alongside category discovery. Test whether dense campaign modules obscure product details; verify technical, stock and fulfillment claims.

scent-family collection grid
returns/quality propositions and sustainability/newsletter footer
observations.design_hypothesis: Scent-family navigation can connect a multi-category fragrance assortment; product-page narratives and usage details should match the product type. Verify product consistency and substantiation behind ingredients and sustainability statements.

trending products and Escape the Everyday editorial
sustainability/service statements, blog and newsletter
observations.design_hypothesis: Editorial campaign content can add context to category-led fashion browsing; ensure collection routes, fit guidance and product claims remain clear and substantiated.

homepage_modules: 2026 collections, lifestyle editorial content, Quick View rails, campaign promotion, empty cart drawer source
linen-focused campaign copy and linked category imagery
Everyday Essentials and All New product shelves
dress/layer promotional tiles, journal and considered-wear brand story
newsletter offer
observations.design_hypothesis: Public HTML signals only; not pixel-matched visual QA, rendered behaviour or merchant editor access. Seasonal editorial, curated everyday products and garment-care storytelling can support fashion discovery when connected to clear category routes and fit details. Keep recommendation content credible and matched to the active catalog.

gift ideas, showroom links, gift guide/editorial articles and newsletter
observations.design_hypothesis: A jewelry homepage can organize discovery around product category and occasion while explaining care and materials. Let shoppers move from story modules into clear category and product variant choices; substantiate sourcing and production statements.

observations.design_hypothesis: Jewelry discovery can combine gifting, daily styling and materials storytelling. Validate claims, keep collection filters useful at scale, and provide a clear empty-cart path back to categories.

observations.design_hypothesis: Editorial fashion themes and merchandising rails can keep discovery active through sale and seasonal changes. Keep product option availability and fit guidance reliable across collection and PDP.
